column1: Line an 8-inch square pan with foil and grease the foil with 1 tsp butter.
Cube the remaining butter and add it to a large saucepan with the brown sugar and evaporated milk.
Bring to a full boil over medium heat while stirring constantly, then cook 10 minutes, stirring often.
Take off the heat and stir in the maple flavoring, vanilla, and salt.
Add the confectioners' sugar and beat on medium speed about 2 minutes until smooth.
Spread right away into the prepared pan and let cool completely.
Lift the fudge out using the foil, peel off the foil, and cut into 1-inch squares.
